GEOGRAPHY — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   D. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.

2. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

3. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   D. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.

4. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

5. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   C. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.

6. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   B. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   D. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   B. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Rocks as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   C. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   C. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

12. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

13. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   C. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.

14. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.

15. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   C. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.

16. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Rocks and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
